CPI index value

An index level measures prices relative to a defined base period. It is not itself an inflation percentage. Read it with the index base and methodology published by the source.

Reading this report responsibly
01 / Period

Check the month and year of the release before comparing values. Different periods should not be treated as simultaneous observations.

02 / Method

Confirm the CPI base year, classification and methodology in the original statistical bulletin.

03 / Household impact

National averages do not describe every household. Personal inflation varies with location, spending patterns and income.

Source coverage

Independent datasets are shown with their own frequency and methodology.
